item: Thirteen dead top-level functions nobody called are deleted (A-037, C12 part 1, R446)
key_paths: src/analytics/equivalence.py; src/analytics/lunar.py; src/analytics/translation_store.py; src/backup/attribution.py; src/backup/import_reports.py; src/backup/parity.py; src/catalog/provenance_scope.py; src/database/__init__.py; src/database/source_manager.py; src/monitoring/unlock_marker.py
summary: Top-level functions in files no lane or open PR holds, with no caller in src, src/static, scripts, configs, migrations or tests (rg -w over each name) are deleted: ring_terms, candidate_languages, _pearson_centered, record_tentative_batch, attribution_markdown, _report_outcome, _load_padded, curated_filter, query_data, store_data, search_collection, get_source_manager, last_done_at. Imports they alone used went with them. No behaviour change. Deferred because the file is held: close_session (WAL, database/session.py), instrument_search and four comments naming it (#1758), _python_sort_key (#1783, #1772), _small_corpus_note (#1766), CompressedJSON (#1761, #1754), app_is_locked (Export, R449). Left alone on purpose: unicode_withheld_traceback (passphrase-rule file), SpellDelete, LinkClassificationRule and SourceCredibilityRule (mapped tables: a drop-table migration is deferred past 0.6, R452), the test-only names. Release-notes line: none; internal cleanup, nothing an operator sees.
